decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach card to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, using cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to fuel the combo. The deck includes various artifacts and can generate mana quickly with Mox Opal and Mox Amber. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps to dig for combo pieces, while Malevolent Rumble and Unholy Heat provide removal and disruption. Mishra's Bauble and Mishra's Research Desk help to draw cards and set up the combo. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly assembling the combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with repeated spell casts.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and fast damage output, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride. The deck also includes powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off opponents. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provide additional support and buff creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly before they can stabilize, utilizing a mix of creatures, spells, and enchantments to maintain pressure and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures with powerful abilities like Phage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to boost the effectiveness of the creatures. Additionally, the deck incorporates disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's strategy. Utilizing a combination of creatures, spells, and lands, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and efficiently close out games through aggressive plays and strategic decision-making.

The deck aims to generate a large amount of mana quickly through rituals and mana reducers like Ruby Medallion, in order to cast powerful spells like Past in Flames and Ral, Monsoon Mage multiple times in a single turn. It also utilizes card draw effects like Reckless Impulse and Glimpse the Impossible to dig through the deck and find key combo pieces. By chaining spells together efficiently, the deck can create explosive turns and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and powerful spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently control the board with removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, while also buffing up creatures with Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. The deck also includes cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of strong creatures like Ocelot Pride and versatile spells like Thraben Charm, this deck aims to win the game through fast, aggressive plays.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to maintain a high level of aggression through a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure on the opponent, while also using cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt their game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Thraben Charm and Goblin Bombardment for additional reach and removal options. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on using powerful Eldrazi creatures to ramp up mana quickly, while controlling the board with disruptive spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, while also having access to removal options like Kozilek's Return. The deck utilizes cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate mana production, allowing the player to cast their big Eldrazi creatures ahead of schedule.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing low-cost creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also incorporates cards that provide additional utility and support, such as Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls. By combining efficient creatures with removal and utility spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory. The inclusion of powerful cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker further enhances the deck's aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy using a variety of counterspells and removal spells while generating card advantage with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Snapcaster Mage. It aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent through efficient card selection and powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The mana base is optimized for quick access to the deck's spells and to ensure consistent color sources. Overall, the deck combines control elements with strong creatures and card advantage to dominate the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells while maintaining card advantage and threat density. Built around a Dimir color combination, the deck utilizes cards like Fatal Push, Counterspell, and Thoughtseize to keep the opponent's board in check. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Undercity Sewers provide powerful win conditions, while spells like Thought Scour and Unearth help in digging for key cards and recurring threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around denying the opponent resources and slowly grinding out a victory.

This deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and disruptive creatures to control the game and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. It also includes cards that mill the opponent's library and provide card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes some utility lands. The deck aims to grind out the opponent's resources and eventually win the game through attrition.

The deck focuses on controlling the game early through mana ramp and removal spells, then dropping powerful Eldrazi creatures to dominate the late game. Cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse help accelerate mana production, while Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble provide disruption against opponents. The deck's win conditions come in the form of powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, backed up by utility spells like Ancient Stirrings. The deck also includes some card draw and protection spells to ensure consistency and resilience in long games.

This deck focuses on using the combo between Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to mill through your library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble provide additional card advantage and the ability to recur key pieces. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Spell Snare and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect the combo. Overall, the goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure a victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. Utilizing powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison can disrupt the opponent's game plan, giving the deck an advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. The key strategy is to control the board with efficient removal like Fatal Push and Psychic Frog, while countering important spells with Counterspell and Spell Snare. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat that can close out the game quickly. The deck also utilizes Thought Scour and Unearth for card advantage and graveyard interaction. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and establish control before winning the game.

The deck aims to ramp up quickly using Amulet of Vigor and various land tutors to quickly generate large amounts of mana. By playing Primeval Titan and utilizing land synergies, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game. The combination of lands like Gruul Turf, Simic Growth Chamber, and Primeval Titan allows the deck to generate massive amounts of mana and potentially win the game in just a few turns.
